bazel

Bazel reporting that an action or target failed. A wrapper - the compiler or test output it relays is the cause.

anybuildwrappermatcher

Open in playgroundFile on GitHubHistory

Install: ci-doctor matchers add official/bazel

matchers/any/bazel/matcher.yaml

id: bazel
role: wrapper
classification: [any, build]
description: Bazel reporting that an action or target failed. A wrapper - the compiler or test output it relays is the cause.
pattern: '^ERROR: \S+:\d+:\d+: .*(failed|FAILED)|^FAILED: Build did NOT complete|^//\S+\s+FAILED in \d'
before: 2
after: 10
